entries.description: Refusal gate marked 150/265 unanswerable questions answerable — a 56.6% false-answer rate reported at the Sprint 2 gate as zero
entries.cause: Test set too small and too easy, written by the implementer

entries.description: Evidence gate answered a value-demanding question the corpus never answers, scoring 8.85
entries.cause: Similarity signals cannot distinguish "about this subject" from "answers this question"

entries.description: Re-ranker experiment returned a null result that was two bugs: a NaN checkpoint and a saturated metric
entries.cause: NaN sorts as a no-op; document-level MRR was already 0.986

entries.description: Seed loader destroyed one embedding model's vectors when reloading under another
Retry loop re-sent an identical prompt, so it could never succeed
entries.cause: Design oversight: the edge existed, the feedback did not

entries.description: Semantic cache served the previous answer to a correction retry (0.886 similarity vs 0.60 threshold)
entries.cause: **Emergent interaction between two individually correct, individually measured components**

entries.description: `RUN_BUDGET_USD=0` killed every run mid-stream with an unhandled error
CSP blocked React hydration in development; every button was inert HTML
entries.cause: A policy correct for production made development impossible

entries.description: The console displayed assessments the governance layer had refused to emit
Spend reservation priced against `providers[0]`, under-reserving 4x when failover reached a costlier provider
entries.cause: The guard assumed the cheapest candidate would serve

adrs.title: ADR-0001 — Split the experience layer from the agent runtime
ADR-0002 — The product name is build-time configuration, not source
ADR-0003 — Host the agent runtime on Hugging Face Spaces (free CPU)
ADR-0004 — No local neural embedding model in the container
ADR-0005 — Vectors from different embedding models are never compared
ADR-0006 — Human-approval nodes are terminal by construction
ADR-0007 — Rate limiting and the spend guard fail closed
ADR-0008 — Similarity thresholds belong to the embedder, not to the cache
ADR-0009 — Models are trained offline and served without their training framework
ADR-0010 — Training labels are true by construction, never model-generated
ADR-0011 — No approximate-nearest-neighbour index until the corpus reaches ~5,000 chunks
